subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should this fix exclude test-named files only from `plugins.code_safety`, or also from installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans?
rationale: The current patch changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader scan boundary than the plugin-focused false-positive report requires.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an option through the helper and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept the installed-skill security tradeoff and ask for proof covering that surface.

options.title: Pause for audit policy
options.body: Hold this PR while the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another audit strategy should be the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an option through the helper and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit helper and skills-surface commits make this the best available routing signal for the scan-boundary decision.
